citation.journal: Journal of the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology

record.population: Caucasian (straight, wavy, curly) and Afro-ethnic hair tresses
record.design: Laboratory comparison of bleaching or dyeing, thioglycolate straightening, brushing with a flat iron, and UVA/visible light
record.finding: Bleaching, dyeing and UV light increased the combing work of afro-ethnic tresses, indicating cuticle damage confirmed by electron microscopy. Bleaching and dyeing caused wear on cuticles with high protein loss whatever the curliness. Thioglycolate straightening faded brown and black tresses.
record.note: Hair samples, not people. The abstract does not report a result for flat-iron heat alone.
